sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: Thai-Nichi Enterprise is looking for companies in Thailand that can use or distribute its ingredients: food processors, supplement manufacturers, ingredient distributors and pet nutrition businesses.
The range pairs seasoning raw materials with functional ingredients from Japan, so a partner can approach it as one ingredient source across food, supplement and pet applications.

sections.heading: About the company
paragraphs: Thai-Nichi Enterprise Co., Ltd. is based at Sindhorn Tower 3 in central Bangkok. Its website organizes the business into seasoning products, health products and plant-based food ingredients, under the values Delicious, Enjoy and Healthy.
Third-party listings give 1992 as the founding year; this should be confirmed from registration documents during due diligence.

sections.heading: Ingredients on offer
paragraphs: QOL Bacillus Natto is described by the company as a Bacillus subtilis subsp. natto strain selected from natto, supplied as a sterilized bacterial powder that can be incorporated into various processed foods, with over 100 billion natto bacteria per gram. Ginger Extract NE and Minelact Lactiplantibacillus sit in the same health-product group. This profile makes no health claims; wording on finished products in Thailand must follow local rules and approved claims.

For pet food, the company's fish extracts are made from several tuna species, go through enzymatic treatment and concentration, and are stated to be suited as raw ingredients for sauces, seasonings and pet foods. Whether natto powder or ginger extract suit pet formulations has not been confirmed.
The plant-based group includes Masking Taste, a spice extract powder used at 0.05% to 0.15% to reduce soybean odor and bitterness in formulations.

sections.heading: Expansion in Thailand
paragraphs: The company already operates from Bangkok, so the aim is to widen use of its ingredients with local manufacturers and channels. Specific territories, volumes and timelines are not published.

sections.heading: Who is a good fit
paragraphs: Suitable partners hold or can obtain the Thai registrations needed for their category, have formulation or technical teams, and can describe a concrete product plan such as a supplement, a processed food or a pet product.
Distributors with existing relations to food, supplement or pet-food manufacturers are also relevant.

sections.heading: Points to consider
paragraphs: Ingredient claims, labelling and registration depend on product type and are governed by Thai authorities. Partners should confirm specifications, documentation and permitted wording with the supplier before development.
Exclusivity, pricing, minimum volumes and territory scope are not published and are not offered through this page.

sections.heading: Why consider this introduction
paragraphs: The opportunity is introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), which helps qualified companies reach a structured first conversation with the supplier.
